name: Dovan Strake
excerpt: Dovan Strake is a person with whom Rella Corse has a complex relationship.
notes:
- Dovan Strake met Rella Corse during her freelance chart correction work period in the harbor district.
- The nature of their introduction is unknown.
- Strake has a long-running argument with Rella Corse, which is not clearly characterized as either antagonism or friendship.

- Dovan Strake, when asked about the Inkhand, became less jovial and changed the subject.

- Dovan Strake is a founding member of the Tide Compact.
- Handles buyers for the Compact and is known to be affable and loud.
- Drinks at the Wrecked Compass three nights a week and is well-liked.
- Operates out of a chandlery in Salt Warren.
